AI forces a “paranoid reading” style on people who don’t want to be paranoid readers and on non-using writers who just want to be taken on their own (human) terms. 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/ai-imposes...
California analysis meta: Cast your vote and then wait a full week after Election Day before forming your first complete thought about the results.

A general rule of thumb for bad media ownership situations is that everything is set against an attention market of growing competition / falling demand, and the Wall Street vampires know how to still eke out margins in that game while the vanity billionaires from outside the sector, um, don’t.

This is also where I’m a bit bearish on the left-antitrustish critiques of the whole situation, in that the insanely competitive media environment gives CBS viewers an infinite amount of other things they can do with their time than spend an hour with an obviously deteriorating product.

AI forces a “paranoid reading” style on people who don’t want to be paranoid readers and on non-using writers who just want to be taken on their own (human) terms. 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/ai-imposes...

Scott Pelley tells the NYT: "The collapse of values at the top has become untenable. The leadership of ‘60 Minutes’ is no longer recognizable. The principles I hold dear are gone." www.nytimes.com/2026/06/02/b...

Bilton era going great so far!

www.wsj.com/business/med...
unless Trump made being a media boss a protected class (always possible I suppose)
that’s not what “hostile work environment” means
"Artificial intelligence is an anti-community technology whose principal civic innovation is to reduce social trust and engender a greater sense of unreality in our lives."

too much computer 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/ai-imposes...

This whole story illustrates my thesis that LLMs are not a democratizing technology; they are an anti-egalitarian technology.

As inboxes fill with these kind of scams, authors are forced to ignore cold emails and genuine good faith messages from the community get ignored.
Those who mark students’ work already know a particularly pronounced version of this, I think.

Strong feeling that uni lecturers are the canary in this particular coal mine. The best thing* about marking work is getting enthusiastic about students' enthusiasm. But we can't do that anymore; we have to constantly suspicious. It stinks.

According to my termination letter from @washingtonpost.com a, the company cited these two Bluesky posts, and claimed that I disparaged white men, accused me of ‘gross misconduct’, and that my Bluesky posts “potentially endanger[ed] the physical safety of our staff”.
This quote is spot on
Rob I hope your ears were burning, you were subconsciously somewhere in the back of my head when I was pondering all this.

"AI" means no more good-faith assumptions of a writer's investment and attention on the basis of their text; it imposes a collective and metastasizing burden of paranoia on everyone  
mattdpearce.substack.com/p/ai-imposes...
